solutions.title: Lead Generation Solutions for B2B and B2C Businesses
solutions.intro: Choose the support your business needs, from a focused paid campaign to a broader acquisition strategy. We recommend [digital marketing](/digital-marketing) channels and deliverables based on your goals, resources and sales process.

solution_1.title: Inbound Lead Generation (Organic Search & Content Marketing)
solution_1.body: Attract customers who are searching on Google and AI tools for the products or services you offer. Inbound lead generation brings ready-to-buy visitors to your website through helpful content, strong search rankings, and clear service pages—without relying on paid ads. We connect customer search intent directly to simple inquiry forms, phone calls, and WhatsApp leads, so visitors have a clear path to contact your business. Our organic marketing approach focuses on four proven pillars:

point_1.title: High-Intent Service Pages
point_1.description: Website pages that answer customer questions about pricing, process, and benefits.

point_2.title: Google & AI Search Visibility
point_2.description: Optimizing your website to rank in Google search results, Featured Snippets, and AI recommendations (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity).

point_3.title: Helpful Guides & Resources
point_3.description: Blogs, FAQs, and case studies to build trust for customers.

point_4.title: Clear Conversion Paths
point_4.description: Enquiry forms, click-to-call buttons, and WhatsApp chat options where visitors are ready to take action.

solution_1.follow_up: Want to bring more leads without paying for online advertising? Explore our [SEO Services](/seo) and AI Search Visibility Services.

point_4.title: Conversion Tracking

solution_2.follow_up: Wish to grow your customer inquiries? Explore our [Google Ads services](/search-engine-marketing) and [social media marketing services](/social-media-marketing).

solution_3.title: B2B Lead Generation
solution_3.body: Reach business owners and corporate decision-makers who are looking for a trusted partner. We build targeted B2B lead generation campaigns across Google Search, LinkedIn and other social medias, tailored to your ideal industry, company size, and sales cycle.
solution_3.schema_description: Targeted campaigns designed to reach business owners and corporate decision-makers based on industry, company size and sales requirements.

solution_4.title: B2C and Local Lead Generation
solution_4.body: Reach everyday consumers and local customers who are searching for your products or services. We run targeted B2C and local lead generation campaigns across Google Search, Google Maps, Facebook, and Instagram—designed to drive phone calls, WhatsApp chats, and store visits. We focus on the exact cities and neighborhoods your business serve, and connecting local buyer intent with fast, mobile-friendly ways to contact your team.
solution_4.schema_description: Local and consumer-focused campaigns using Google Search, Google Maps, Facebook and Instagram to generate enquiries, calls and store visits.

solution_5.title: Landing Pages and Conversion Optimisation
solution_5.body: Convert clicks into real customer inquiries with dedicated, fast-loading website landing pages. Rather than sending ad visitors to a general homepage, we build focused pages with clear offers, simple benefits, mobile-friendly layouts, and short inquiry forms—removing friction between customer interest and action.

We help you capture, track, and nurture incoming leads through CRM integration, instant sales team alerts, lead qualification forms, and automated email or WhatsApp follow-ups. Together with your team, we map out a simple workflow so every enquiry reaches the right person fast.
solution_6.schema_description: Lead qualification forms, CRM integration, instant sales team notifications and automated email or WhatsApp follow-ups.

Depending on your budget, target customers, and sales goals, these lead generation methods can be used individually or combined into a complete growth strategy. Grehasoft helps businesses in Kochi, Kerala, and beyond select the most effective channels—focusing on practical campaigns that deliver real inquiries and measurable ROI. [Get in touch with our team to plan your next lead generation campaign.](#enquiry-form)

metrics.title: How We Measure Lead Quality & Campaign ROI
metrics.intro: We measure success by real business inquiries and sales opportunities. Our reports clearly separate your ad spend from service cost and track six core metrics.

stage_1.label: Visitors
stage_1.description: People who reach your website or landing page

stage_3.label: Qualified leads
stage_3.description: Enquiries that match your target customer profile

stage_4.label: Sales opportunities

metric_1.title: Lead Volume
metric_1.description: Total valid calls, forms, and WhatsApp inquiries.

metric_2.title: Qualified Lead Rate
metric_2.description: Percentage of leads that match your target customer profile.

metric_3.title: Cost Per Lead (CPL)
metric_3.description: Total ad spend divided by total valid leads captured.

metric_4.title: Cost Per Qualified Lead (CPQL)
metric_4.description: Ad spend divided by sales-qualified leads only.

metric_5.title: Enquiry Conversion Rate
metric_5.description: The percentage of website or landing page visitors who send an enquiry.

metric_6.title: Lead-to-Opportunity Rate
metric_6.description: Percentage of leads that convert into active sales opportunities.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Lead Generation Services

item_1.question: What does Grehasoft do as a lead generation agency?
item_1.answer: Grehasoft, as a lead generation agency, helps your business attract potential customers and capture real sales enquiries. We provide lead generation and management using Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads, SEO, and high-converting landing pages.

item_2.question: Does Grehasoft provide lead generation services in Kochi and Kerala?
item_2.answer: Yes. Grehasoft is based in Infopark, Kochi, and provides custom lead generation services for businesses across Kochi, Ernakulam, Trivandrum, Kozhikode, Thrissur, and all of Kerala. We tailor your campaign channels and local targeting to reach buyers in the exact cities and regions you serve.

item_3.question: What is a qualified lead?
item_3.answer: A qualified lead is a genuine customer enquiry that meets your specific sales criteria—such as the right location, budget, project need, and buying timeline. Not every website form submission is a qualified lead, so we use screening questions and call tracking to filter out spam and low-intent enquiries before your sales team follows up.

item_4.question: Do you support both B2B and B2C lead generation?
item_4.answer: Yes. For B2B lead generation, we target business owners, founders, and corporate decision-makers. For B2C and local lead generation, we target everyday consumers and families using Google Maps, local SEO, Facebook, and Instagram to drive immediate phone calls, WhatsApp chats, and store visits.

item_5.question: Which channels should my business use to get more leads?
item_5.answer: The best channels depend on where your customers search and how fast you want results. Most businesses see the strongest ROI from a combination of Google Search Ads (for high-intent buyers ready to inquire now), Meta Ads (for visual offers and local awareness), and SEO and content (for long-term organic leads), all connected to a fast landing page.

item_6.question: Is lead generation different from SEO and Google Ads?
item_6.answer: Yes. Lead generation is the complete system of attracting visitors, capturing their contact details, qualifying their interest, and handing them over to your sales team. SEO and Google Ads are individual traffic channels used inside that system—alongside landing page design, WhatsApp chat integration, and CRM follow-up.

item_7.question: How much do lead generation services cost in Kerala?
item_7.answer: The cost of lead generation depends on your target market, industry competition, chosen channels (Google Ads, Meta, or SEO), and whether you need landing page design or CRM setup. At Grehasoft, every proposal clearly separates your monthly ad spend (paid directly to Google or Meta) from our agency management fees, with zero hidden charges.

item_8.question: How soon can we expect customer enquiries?
item_8.answer: Paid advertising campaigns on Google Ads, Facebook, and Instagram usually start generating phone calls, form submissions, and WhatsApp leads within 2 to 7 days of launch. SEO and organic content take longer—typically 3 to 6 months—to build top search rankings, though they deliver lower-cost, long-term leads over time.

item_9.question: Can you guarantee a fixed number of leads or sales?
item_9.answer: No ethical digital marketing agency can guarantee an exact number of sales, because final conversions depend on market competition, your pricing, offer strength, and how fast your sales team responds to enquiries. Instead, we agree on clear targets for cost per lead (CPL) and lead quality, and continuously optimize your ads and landing pages to improve ROI.

item_10.question: Who qualifies leads and follows up with prospects?
item_10.answer: We define lead handover responsibilities with your team before launching any campaign. Grehasoft sets up automated qualification questions, instant email and WhatsApp notifications, and CRM routing so enquiries reach your staff immediately. Unless dedicated inside-sales support is included in your scope, your internal sales team calls and closes the prospects.

item_11.question: Can overseas businesses work with Grehasoft?
item_11.answer: Yes. Businesses based in the UAE, GCC, UK, Australia, Canada, and the USA can work with Grehasoft's Kochi team to attract customers in Kerala and India or manage lead generation campaigns targeting buyers in their overseas markets, with time-zone aligned communication and client ownership of advertising accounts.

item_12.question: How do you measure campaign performance and ROI?
item_12.answer: We track real business outcomes rather than vanity clicks. Your reports clearly measure Total Lead Volume, Qualified Lead Rate, Cost Per Lead (CPL), Cost Per Qualified Lead (CPQL), Landing Page Conversion Rate, and Lead-to-Opportunity Rate—always separating your advertising budget from service fees.
